definitions.explanation: The state of being easily damaged, broken, or attacked. Used for physical structures, systems, or situations.
In IT context, a weakness in a system that can be exploited by attackers.

examples.japanese: セキュリティの{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい}が{発見|はっけん}された。
{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}な{地盤|じばん}の{上|うえ}に{建|た}てられた。
examples.english: It was built on fragile ground.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}の{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい}が{露呈|ろてい}した。
examples.english: The fragility of the economy was exposed.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{脆|ぜい/もろ} (brittle, fragile) + {弱|じゃく} (weak)

COMMON FORMS:
・{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}な (na-adjective)
・{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい} (vulnerability - noun with {性|せい})

IT/SECURITY CONTEXT:
・{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい}{診断|しんだん} - vulnerability assessment
・{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい}{対策|たいさく} - vulnerability countermeasures
・ゼロデイ{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい} - zero-day vulnerability
・{脆弱性|ぜいじゃくせい}を{突|つ}く - to exploit a vulnerability

OTHER CONTEXTS:
・{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}な{基盤|きばん} - fragile foundation
・{精神的|せいしんてき}に{脆弱|ぜいじゃく} - mentally fragile
・{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}な{立場|たちば} - vulnerable position

ANTONYM:
{堅牢|けんろう} - robust, solid
